about: Country cards for lives born in United States. Each card is dealt only to them (and a little more often than general cards). Sources are in each card's "src".

events.src: ===================== United States (US) ===================== Student loans: from 1 July 2026 the Repayment Assistance Plan charges a share of income (from a $10 minimum up to 10% of AGI), waives unpaid interest and forgives the rest after 30 years; Public Service Loan Forgiveness clears the balance after 10 years of payments in public or non-profit work (One Big Beautiful Bill Act 2025; NerdWallet; NYC DCWP). A share of about 5% of pay above a small allowance is an ESTIMATE for a typical borrower.

opts.do: sloanInc = { r: .05, th: .2, end: age + 30, pslf: age + 10, waive: 1 }

en..x: Your federal student loans ({a}) are due. The standard plan clears them in 10 years. The Repayment Assistance Plan (from July 2026) takes 1–10% of your income, drops unpaid interest and forgives the rest after 30 years; with Public Service Loan Forgiveness, the balance is cancelled after 10 years of payments in government or non-profit work.
en..rap.s: Payments rise with your pay: about {a} a year at your pay now.

zh..x: 你的联邦学生贷款（{a}）开始要还了。标准方案10年还清。还款援助计划（RAP，2026年7月起）按收入的1–10%还款，免掉未付的利息，30年后剩下的全部免除；若在政府或非营利机构工作，“公共服务贷款减免”在还款10年后免除余额。
zh..rap.s: 还款随收入增加：以现在的收入，每年约{a}。

zht..x: 你的聯邦學生貸款（{a}）開始要還了。標準方案10年還清。還款援助計畫（RAP，2026年7月起）按收入的1–10%還款，免掉未付的利息，30年後剩下的全部免除；若在政府或非營利機構工作，「公共服務貸款減免」在還款10年後免除餘額。
zht..rap.s: 還款隨收入增加：以現在的收入，每年約{a}。

events.src: Cashing out a 401(k): before 59½ a 10% additional tax on top of income tax (IRS); 41.4% of workers leaving a job withdraw money (UBC Sauder study of 162,000 US job changers, via Financial Planning). A 22% income-tax bracket is an ESTIMATE.

out.do: const l = lots.k401, x = l.v * f; l.v -= x; l.tout += x; cash += .68 * x; happy += f > .6 ? 3 : 1; const t = T('us_401k', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.us_401k') }); t.v -= .32 * x; t.note = M('note.us_401k', { a: MN(.32 * x) })

en..x: You’ve changed jobs, and your old 401(k) holds {a}. You can roll it into an IRA or cash it out; before 59½ the IRS adds a 10% penalty on top of income tax. About 4 in 10 Americans who leave a job take money out.
en..cash.s: You get about {a} after tax and the penalty. Happiness +3.
en..half.s: You get about {a} after tax and the penalty. Happiness +1.
en.note.us_401k: Lost {a} to tax and the penalty

zh..x: 你换了工作，旧的401(k)里有{a}。你可以转进IRA，也可以提现；59岁半之前提取，国税局除了所得税还要罚10%。离职的美国人约有四成会把钱提出来。
zh..cash.s: 扣税和罚款后约拿到{a}。幸福感 +3。
zh..half.s: 扣税和罚款后约拿到{a}。幸福感 +1。

zht..x: 你換了工作，舊的401(k)裡有{a}。你可以轉進IRA，也可以提現；59歲半之前提取，國稅局除了所得稅還要罰10%。離職的美國人約有四成會把錢提出來。
zht..cash.s: 扣稅和罰款後約拿到{a}。幸福感 +3。
zht..half.s: 扣稅和罰款後約拿到{a}。幸福感 +1。

events.src: Medical bills: non-profit hospitals must have a written financial assistance policy and limit charges to eligible patients (IRS, section 501(r)); about 6% of adults owe over $1,000 in medical debt (KFF, Feb 2024). Bill size and the chance of a cut are ESTIMATES.

opts.do: const r = evR('medFight'), cut = r() < .55 ? inR(r(), [.3, .8]) : 0, y = a * (1 - cut); pay(y); happy -= 1; const t = line(); t.v -= y; t.note = M('note.us_medbill', { a: MN(a), b: MN(y) })
pay(a); const t = line(); t.v -= a; t.note = M('note.paid', { a: MN(a) })

en..x: A short hospital stay leaves you with a bill of {a}. Non-profit hospitals must offer financial assistance to patients who qualify, and itemised bills sometimes contain errors. About 1 in 16 American adults owe more than $1,000 in medical debt.
en..fight: Ask for an itemised bill and assistance
en..fight.s: Hours of calls and forms. Happiness −1.
en..fight.h: About half the time the bill is cut by a third or more.
en..plan.s: {a} a year for 3 years, no interest.

zh..x: 住院几天后，你收到{a}的账单。非营利医院必须为符合条件的病人提供经济援助，明细账单有时也会出错。大约每16个美国成年人就有一人背着超过1,000美元的医疗债务。
zh..fight: 要求明细账单并申请援助
zh..fight.s: 打好几个小时电话、填一堆表。幸福感 −1。
zh..fight.h: 大约一半的情况账单能减少三分之一以上。

zht..x: 住院幾天後，你收到{a}的帳單。非營利醫院必須為符合條件的病人提供經濟援助，明細帳單有時也會出錯。大約每16個美國成年人就有一人背著超過1,000美元的醫療債務。
zht..fight: 要求明細帳單並申請援助
zht..fight.s: 打好幾個小時電話、填一堆表。幸福感 −1。
zht..fight.h: 大約一半的情況帳單能減少三分之一以上。

events.src: Credit scores and mortgages: in Nov 2025 a $300,000 30-year loan was offered at about 6.57% APR for scores of 760+ and 7.34% for 620–639 (myFICO data via ConsumerAffairs). The rate changes in the game (−0.3 / +0.4 points) are ESTIMATES.

en..x: Lenders price loans by credit score. On a 30-year mortgage in late 2025, borrowers with 760 or more were offered about 6.6% a year, against 7.3% at 620–639.
en..build.s: A starter card for small buys, paid in full every month.
en..build.h: Your mortgage rate later is about 0.3 points lower.
en..none.h: Your mortgage rate later is about 0.4 points higher.

zh..x: 贷款利率要看信用分数。2025年底的30年房贷，信用分760以上的人利率约6.6%，620–639分的人约7.3%。
zh..build.s: 办一张入门信用卡买小东西，每月全额还清。
zh..build.h: 以后的房贷利率约低0.3个百分点。
zh..none.s: 没有卡，也没有信用记录。
zh..none.h: 以后的房贷利率约高0.4个百分点。

zht..x: 貸款利率要看信用分數。2025年底的30年房貸，信用分760以上的人利率約6.6%，620–639分的人約7.3%。
zht..build.s: 辦一張入門信用卡買小東西，每月全額還清。
zht..build.h: 以後的房貸利率約低0.3個百分點。
zht..none.s: 沒有卡，也沒有信用記錄。
zht..none.h: 以後的房貸利率約高0.4個百分點。

events.src: Social Security: claiming at 62 pays about 70% of the full benefit for those with a full retirement age of 67 (born 1960 or later); each year of delay past 67 adds 8%, to 124% at 70 (SSA, as summarised by Fox and The Motley Fool).

en..x: You can claim Social Security from 62 (about 30% less, for life), at 67 (the full amount, for anyone born in 1960 or later), or as late as 70 (24% more).
en..62.s: About {a} a year from age {n}, for life.
en..67.s: About {a} a year from age {n}, for life.
en..70.s: About {a} a year from age {n}, for life.

zh..t: 什么时候领社会保障金
zh..x: 社会保障金最早62岁可以领（终身少约30%），67岁领全额（1960年及以后出生者），最晚70岁领（多24%）。
zh..62.s: 从{n}岁起每年约{a}，终身领取。
zh..67.s: 从{n}岁起每年约{a}，终身领取。
zh..70.s: 从{n}岁起每年约{a}，终身领取。

zht..t: 什麼時候領社會保障金
zht..x: 社會保障金最早62歲可以領（終身少約30%），67歲領全額（1960年及以後出生者），最晚70歲領（多24%）。
zht..62.s: 從{n}歲起每年約{a}，終身領取。
zht..67.s: 從{n}歲起每年約{a}，終身領取。
zht..70.s: 從{n}歲起每年約{a}，終身領取。

events.src: Childcare: the national average price was $13,128 a year in 2024, up from $11,582 in 2023 (Child Care Aware of America, May 2025). The game already counts a child's basic costs, so the card adds the part above them (about 0.25 of a typical wage): an ESTIMATE.

opts.do: T('us_daycare', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.daycare') }); rec('us_daycare', .25 * B, 4)
T('us_daycare', { kind: 'custom', label: M('trk.daycareF') }); rec('us_daycare', .04 * B, 4); happy -= 1

en..x: Full-time childcare cost $13,128 a year on average in 2024. One of you could cut back to part-time until school starts, or family could help.
en..daycare.s: About {a} a year for 4 years, on top of the usual costs of a child.
en..part.s: About 45% less pay for 4 years. More time at home: Happiness +2.
en..family.s: You help with their costs: about {a} a year. Less freedom: Happiness −1.

zh..x: 2024年全日制托儿平均每年要13,128美元。你们其中一人可以改做兼职到孩子上学，或者请家人帮忙。
zh..daycare.s: 每年约{a}，共4年，养孩子的一般开销另计。
zh..part.s: 4年内工资少约45%。更多时间在家：幸福感 +2。
zh..family.s: 你帮忙负担他们的开销：每年约{a}。自由少了：幸福感 −1。

zht..x: 2024年全日制托育平均每年要13,128美元。你們其中一人可以改做兼職到孩子上學，或者請家人幫忙。
zht..daycare.s: 每年約{a}，共4年，養孩子的一般開銷另計。
zht..part.s: 4年內薪水少約45%。更多時間在家：幸福感 +2。
zht..family.s: 你幫忙負擔他們的開銷：每年約{a}。自由少了：幸福感 −1。

events.src: FHA loans: 3.5% down with a credit score of 580+, an upfront mortgage insurance premium of 1.75% of the loan and an annual premium of 0.55% for the loan's life with under 10% down (HUD Mortgagee Letter 2023-05; Quicken Loans).

opts.ok: liq >= .083 * P || M('e.home.need', { n: MN(.083 * P), h: MN(liq) })
opts.do: buyAt(P, { dp: .035, fee: .0475, r: .0355, n: 30, lk: 'trk.flat' })

en..x: An FHA loan lets you buy with 3.5% down if your credit score is 580 or more, but you pay 1.75% of the loan up front and 0.55% a year in mortgage insurance for the life of the loan. A starter home near you costs {p}.
en..fha.s: {d} up front, then {m} a year for 30 years.
en..wait: Save for a bigger down payment

zh..x: FHA贷款让信用分580以上的人只付3.5%首付就能买房，但要先付贷款额1.75%的房贷保险费，之后整个贷款期间每年再付0.55%。你附近一间入门房子要{p}。

zht..x: FHA貸款讓信用分580以上的人只付3.5%頭期款就能買房，但要先付貸款額1.75%的房貸保險費，之後整個貸款期間每年再付0.55%。你附近一間入門房子要{p}。

events.src: Health Savings Account: with a high-deductible plan, contributions are deductible and growth and medical withdrawals are tax-free (IRS Publication 969). The tax saving (about 25%) and the higher share of each bill you pay are ESTIMATES.

opts.do: yearly('hsa', { amt: a, until: 65, bonus: .25 }, {}, 'trk.hsa'); medCut = 1.15

en..x: At open enrollment you can pick a high-deductible plan with a Health Savings Account: you pay more of each bill before cover starts, but money you put in the HSA is never taxed if it’s spent on health care, and it can be invested.
en..hsa.s: Put about {a} a year in the HSA. You pay more of each medical bill yourself.

zh..x: 开放投保期间，你可以选高自付额保险加健康储蓄账户（HSA）：保险生效前你要多付一些，但存进HSA的钱只要用在医疗上就永远不用缴税，而且可以拿去投资。
zh..hsa.s: 每年存约{a}进HSA。每张医疗账单你要自己多付一些。

zht..x: 開放投保期間，你可以選高自付額保險加健康儲蓄帳戶（HSA）：保險生效前你要多付一些，但存進HSA的錢只要用在醫療上就永遠不用繳稅，而且可以拿去投資。
zht..hsa.s: 每年存約{a}進HSA。每張醫療帳單你要自己多付一些。
